candidates.title: Scissorhands: Exploiting the Persistence of Importance Hypothesis for LLM KV Cache Compression at Test Time
candidates.reason: Foundational test-time KV-cache compression method that maintains a fixed cache budget by preferentially retaining persistently important tokens.

candidates.title: Striped Attention: Faster Ring Attention for Causal Transformers
candidates.reason: Distributed long-context attention algorithm that fixes causal Ring Attention load imbalance and improves end-to-end throughput on GPU/TPU clusters.

candidates.title: InfLLM: Training-Free Long-Context Extrapolation for LLMs with an Efficient Context Memory
candidates.reason: Training-free long-context inference method centered on an efficient external context-memory mechanism, directly relevant to memory-scalable inference.

candidates.title: A Simple and Effective L2 Norm-Based Strategy for KV Cache Compression
candidates.reason: Focused KV-cache compression technique using simple norm-based importance estimation; useful baseline and design point for cache eviction systems.

candidates.title: MInference 1.0: Accelerating Pre-filling for Long-Context LLMs via Dynamic Sparse Attention
candidates.reason: Dynamic sparse-attention inference system targeting long-context prefill, with practical kernel/system optimizations and substantial latency reduction.
